objects.name: Researcher Drops BigDiskBuster Zero-Day PoC That Blocks Microsoft Defender Updates
objects.description: A zero-day proof-of-concept tool that stops Microsoft Defender from installing platform and signature updates by filling all available disk space was published on GitHub on September 19.
